handoffSettings.title: Handoff and assignment
handoffSettings.subtitle: How a conversation reaches a person once a bot, a flow or a teammate asks for one, and how the contact owner and the chat owner work together.
handoffSettings.noAccess: You do not have permission to see these settings. Ask a workspace Owner or Admin for the inbox settings permission.
handoffSettings.readOnly: You can see these settings but not change them.
handoffSettings.loadFailed: The settings could not be loaded.
handoffSettings.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.
handoffSettings.upgradeHint: Your plan does not include this. Ask the account owner to upgrade the plan.

auto.title: Automatic assignment
auto.body: When a person is needed, the assignment rules can pick one for you. Without them, the conversation waits in the Waiting tab until a teammate claims it.
auto.switchHint: Turn off to stop the assignment rules from running, both for new conversations and for handoffs. Conversations then wait in the queue or go to the person or team a flow names.

owner.title: Contact owner and chat owner
owner.body: A contact can have an owner, and each conversation has the person who answers it. Choose how the two relate.
owner.modeLabel: How the contact owner and the chat owner relate

independent.title: Independent
independent.body: The chat owner and the contact owner are separate. Nothing changes one when the other changes.

owner_first.title: Owner first
owner_first.body: A new chat goes to the contact's owner first when they can take it; otherwise the usual rules decide.

keep_in_sync.title: Keep in sync
keep_in_sync.body: As owner first, and when a contact's owner changes, their open chats that were assigned automatically follow. A chat a person took is never moved.

owner.claimSets: Claiming makes you the contact owner
owner.claimSetsHint: When someone claims a conversation and the contact has no owner yet, they become the owner.
owner.prompt: Ask about the contact owner on reassign
owner.promptHint: When a chat is given to someone else by hand, offer to make them the contact owner too.
owner.window: Keep a returning contact with their last agent
owner.windowHint: A contact who writes again goes to the person who handled their last conversation, for this many days. Off means no limit.

queue.title: Waiting queue
queue.body: Conversations nobody could take wait in the Waiting tab of the inbox, with the reason and how long they have waited.
queue.notify: Tell the team when a conversation is waiting
queue.notifyHint: Members of the team, or everyone who can answer unassigned chats, get a notification with the reason.

teams.title: Teams
teams.body: Each team has its own assignment method, opening hours, time zone and default assignee. They are used whenever a conversation is handed to that team.
